C0782.title: Xinference Supply Chain Poisoning Incident
C0782.summary: In April 2026, Xinference's PyPI release chain was poisoned and versions 2.6.0, 2.6.1, and 2.6.2 contained malicious code. JFrog and NSFOCUS reported that the payload was placed in xinference/__init__.py, could run when the package was imported, enumerated environment variables and local configuration paths, and collected cloud credentials, SSH keys, API tokens, database connection data, and other secrets for exfiltration. The affected versions were later removed from PyPI, and users were advised to upgrade and rotate exposed credentials.
